```{r  data_loading}
# Set working directory
setwd("/scratch/Shares/rinn/ML/RNAseq_FULL_MODEL/combined time")

# Define base path and cell line IDs
base_path <- "/scratch/Shares/rinn/lincxpress/"
linc_ids <- c("GFP", "GFP_12Sept2024", "BANCR", "HULC", "RP11", "CRNDE", "DANCR203", "FENDRR", 
              "LINC00667", "LINC00847", "LINC01547", "HAGLR", "HEIH", "LINCPINT", "LINCROR", 
              "LNCPRESS1", "PNKY", "TUG1_210", "TUG1_217", "hipsc_empty")

# Initialize list to store raw count data
counts_list <- list()

# Loop through IDs and load data
for (linc_id in linc_ids) {
  file_path <- file.path(base_path, linc_id, "rnaseq/nextflow_results/star_salmon/salmon.merged.gene_counts.tsv")
  
  if (file.exists(file_path)) {
    cat("Loading:", file_path, "\n")
    counts_list[[linc_id]] <- read.table(file_path, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", row.names = 1)
  } else {
    cat("Warning: File not found:", file_path, "\n")
  }
}

# 1. Create GeneID to GeneName mapping (g2s) using the first available dataset
first_id <- names(counts_list)[1]
g2s <- data.frame(
  gene_id = rownames(counts_list[[first_id]]),
  gene_name = counts_list[[first_id]][, 1]
)

# 2. Clean data: Remove gene_name column and round counts (integers required for DESeq2)
for (linc_id in names(counts_list)) {
  counts_list[[linc_id]] <- counts_list[[linc_id]][, -1]
  counts_list[[linc_id]] <- round(counts_list[[linc_id]])
}

# 3. Intersect common genes across all datasets
common_genes <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(counts_list, rownames))
counts_list <- lapply(counts_list, function(df) df[common_genes, , drop = FALSE])

# 4. Combine into a single matrix
combined_counts <- do.call(cbind, unname(counts_list))

# 5. Create Metadata (col_data) and clean sample names
col_data <- data.frame(sample_id = colnames(combined_counts))

# Apply regex to standardize sample names
# Format: Condition_c{Clone}b{Batch}_Time
colnames(combined_counts) <- gsub("^([A-Za-z]+)_C(\\d+)_B(\\d+)_", "\\1c\\2b\\3_", col_data$sample_id)
colnames(combined_counts) <- gsub("^([A-Za-z0-9]+)_C(\\d+)_B(atch)?(\\d+)_", "\\1c\\2b\\4_", col_data$sample_id)
colnames(combined_counts) <- gsub("GFP_", "GFPc18_", colnames(combined_counts))
colnames(combined_counts) <- gsub("LINC\\.ROR_", "LINCROR_", colnames(combined_counts))

# Update col_data sample_id to match matrix column names
col_data$sample_id <- colnames(combined_counts)

# Create a combined data frame with gene names for easy lookup later
combined_counts_plus <- as.data.frame(combined_counts) %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene_id") %>%
  merge(g2s, by = "gene_id")

# 6. Parse Metadata (Condition, Time, Replicate)
split_values <- strsplit(col_data$sample_id, "_")
col_data$condition <- sapply(split_values, function(x) x[[1]])
col_data$time <- sapply(split_values, function(x) x[[2]])
col_data$replicate <- sapply(split_values, function(x) x[[3]])

# Set Time as Factor with specific levels order
time_levels <- c("0", "0.5", "1", "1.5", "2", "2.5", "3", "3.5", "4", "4.5", "5", "5.5", "8", "12", "16", "24", "48", "96")
col_data$time <- factor(col_data$time, levels = time_levels)

# Save intermediate data
save(combined_counts_plus, col_data, g2s, file = "results/combined_counts_with_gene_name.RData")
```

```{r deseq_analysis}
# Initialize lists
dds_list <- list()
res_list <- list()
all_results_df <- data.frame()

# Get unique cell lines (conditions)
conditions <- unique(col_data$condition)

# Loop: Run DESeq2 for each condition individually
for (cond in conditions) {
  message("Processing condition: ", cond)
  
  # Subset data for current condition
  sub_col_data <- col_data[col_data$condition == cond, ]
  sub_counts <- combined_counts[, sub_col_data$sample_id]
  
  # Ensure time levels are consistent
  sub_col_data$time <- factor(as.character(sub_col_data$time), levels = levels(col_data$time))
  
  # DESeq2 Object
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = sub_counts,
                                colData = sub_col_data,
                                design = ~ time)
  
  # Run LRT (Likelihood Ratio Test) for time series
  dds <- DESeq(dds, test = "LRT", reduced = ~1)
  
  dds_list[[cond]] <- dds
  res_list[[cond]] <- results(dds)
  
  # Extract all results (Time X vs Time 0)
  res_names <- resultsNames(dds)[-1] # Remove Intercept
  
  for (res_name in res_names) {
    res <- results(dds, name = res_name)
    
    # Tidy format
    tmp_df <- as.data.frame(res) %>%
      rownames_to_column("gene_id") %>%
      left_join(g2s, by = "gene_id") %>%
      mutate(
        condition = cond,
        result_name = res_name,
        # Extract numeric timepoint from result name (e.g., time_24_vs_0)
        timepoint = as.numeric(sub("time_([0-9\\.]+)_vs_0", "\\1", res_name))
      )
    
    all_results_df <- bind_rows(all_results_df, tmp_df)
  }
}

save(dds_list, res_list, all_results_df, file = "results/all_results_df.RData")
```

```{r Complex Composite Plot (Sparklines + Global Boxplot)}
# --- 1. Prepare Boxplot Data (Middle Panel) ---

# Step 1: Filter padj ≤ 0.01
filtered_df <- all_results_df %>%
  filter(padj <= 0.01 & baseMean >= 20)

# Step 2: Compute max FC per gene per condition
maxfc_df <- filtered_df %>%
  group_by(condition, gene_id) %>%
  summarize(
    max_fc = log2FoldChange[which.max(abs(log2FoldChange))],
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Step 3: Join and filter for max_fc ≥ 1
filtered_df <- filtered_df %>%
  left_join(maxfc_df, by = c("condition", "gene_id")) %>%
  filter(max_fc >= 1 | max_fc <= -1)

# Step 4: Mark up/down direction
filtered_df <- filtered_df %>%
  mutate(
    up = log2FoldChange >= 0.58,
    down = log2FoldChange <= -0.58
  )

# Step 5: Use only late timepoints to determine consistent genes
valid_time_points <- c(24, 48, 96)

trend_summary <- filtered_df %>%
  filter(timepoint %in% valid_time_points) %>%
  group_by(condition, gene_id) %>%
  summarize(
    up_count = sum(up, na.rm = TRUE),
    down_count = sum(down, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_comparisons = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(total_comparisons == length(valid_time_points)) %>%
  filter(up_count >= 3 | down_count >= 3)

# 修复连接问题
filtered_df<- filtered_df %>%
  inner_join(trend_summary[, c("condition", "gene_id")], 
             by = c("condition", "gene_id"))

# 筛选特定细胞系：GFP 只使用 GFPc5b2，LINC00667 只使用 LINC00667c4b1，TUG1210 只使用 TUG1210c9b1
filtered_df<- filtered_df %>%
  filter(!(str_detect(condition, "^GFP") & condition != "GFPc5b2")) %>%
  filter(!(str_detect(condition, "^LINC00667") & condition != "LINC00667c4b1")) %>%
  filter(!(str_detect(condition, "^TUG1210") & condition != "TUG1210c9"))


# Assign direction (Up/Down)
filtered_df <- filtered_df %>%
  mutate(direction = ifelse(log2FoldChange > 0, "Up", "Down"))

# Extract data for plotting: one point per gene per condition (max absolute FC)
plot_data_box <- filtered_df %>%
  group_by(condition, gene_id) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = abs(log2FoldChange), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(clean_name = str_remove(condition, "c[0-9].*"), # Clean condition names
         clean_name = str_remove(clean_name, "_.*"))

# Custom ranking logic
custom_order <- function(names) {
  # Separate WT and GFP
  wt_gfp <- c("WT", "GFP")
  wt_gfp_present <- wt_gfp[wt_gfp %in% names]
  
  # Get other names (excluding WT and GFP) and sort alphabetically
  other_names <- setdiff(names, wt_gfp)
  other_names_sorted <- sort(other_names)
  
  # Combine: WT, GFP, then sorted other names
  return(c(wt_gfp_present, other_names_sorted))
}

# Get unique clean_names
all_clean_names <- unique(plot_data_box$clean_name)

# Create custom order
custom_order_vec <- custom_order(all_clean_names)

# Apply ordering to clean_name factor
plot_data_box$clean_name <- factor(plot_data_box$clean_name, levels = custom_order_vec)

# Calculate counts for Up/Down labels
stats_df <- plot_data_box %>%
  group_by(clean_name, direction) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(y_pos = ifelse(direction == "Up", 0.5, -0.5), label = as.character(count))

# --- 2. Plot Lower Part (Boxplot) ---

p_box <- ggplot(plot_data_box, aes(x = clean_name, y = log2FoldChange)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = direction), width = 0.25, size = 0.6, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white", color = "black", 
               width = 0.6, size = 0.6, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey60") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  # Add count labels
  geom_text(data = stats_df, aes(x = clean_name, y = y_pos, label = label, color = direction), 
           size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Up" = "#B2182B", "Down" = "#2166AC")) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-16, 12.5)) + 
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, color = "black"),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Max log2FC")

# --- 3. Prepare Sparklines Data (Top Panel) ---

# Map cell line names to target gene symbols
target_gene_map <- c(
  "TUG1210"   = "TUG1",
  "TUG1217"   = "TUG1",
  "PNKY"      = "RP1-273N12.4",
  "RP11"      = "RP11-1055B8.4",
  "LINCPINT"  = "LINC-PINT",
  "LINCROR"   = "LINC-ROR",
  "LINC00667" = "LINC00667", 
  "LINC00847" = "LINC00847", 
  "HULC"      = "HULC",
  "LINC01547" = "LINC01547",
  "DANCR203"  = "DANCR",     
  "HEIH"      = "HEIH",
  "FENDRR"    = "FENDRR",
  "CRNDE"     = "CRNDE",
  "LNCPRESS1" = "LNCPRESS1",
  "BANCR"     = "BANCR",
  "HAGLR"     = "HAGLR",
  "GFP"       = NA, 
  "WT"        = NA 
)

# Define expected timepoints
expected_timepoints <- c(0, 2, 4, 8, 16, 24, 48, 96)

# Generate Sparkline Data
spark_list <- list()
max_fc_labels <- list() 

ordered_conditions <- custom_order_vec

for (cell_line in ordered_conditions) {
  
  target_gene_symbol <- target_gene_map[cell_line]
  
  # --- Case A: Negative Controls (GFP/WT) ---
  if (is.na(target_gene_symbol)) {
    dummy_df <- data.frame(
      timepoint = expected_timepoints,
      mean_fc = 0, 
      scaled_fc = 0,
      group = "No Target",
      panel_group = cell_line
    )
    spark_list[[cell_line]] <- dummy_df
    
    max_fc_labels[[cell_line]] <- data.frame(
        panel_group = cell_line,
        x_pos = 10, y_pos = 1.1, 
        label = "Control"
    )
    next
  }
  
  # --- Case B: Experimental Lines ---
  gene_data <- all_results_df %>% filter(gene_name == target_gene_symbol)
  
  if(nrow(gene_data) == 0) next
  
  gene_data <- gene_data %>%
    mutate(
      clean_cond = str_remove(condition, "c[0-9].*"),
      clean_cond = str_remove(clean_cond, "_.*")
    )
  
  # 1. Calculate Raw Trends
  # Self trend: filter for this cell line and expected timepoints
  self_trend_raw <- gene_data %>%
    filter(clean_cond == cell_line) %>%
    mutate(timepoint_num = as.numeric(timepoint)) %>%
    filter(timepoint_num %in% expected_timepoints) %>%
    group_by(timepoint_num) %>%
    summarise(mean_fc = mean(log2FoldChange, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") %>%
    rename(timepoint = timepoint_num)
  
  # Force insert 0 point if not present
  if(!0 %in% self_trend_raw$timepoint) {
    self_trend_raw <- bind_rows(
      data.frame(timepoint = 0, mean_fc = 0),
      self_trend_raw
    )
  }
  
  self_trend <- self_trend_raw %>%
    mutate(group = "Target", panel_group = cell_line) %>%
    arrange(timepoint)
  
  # Other trend: filter for other cell lines but same expected timepoints
  other_trend_raw <- gene_data %>%
    filter(clean_cond != cell_line) %>%
    mutate(timepoint_num = as.numeric(timepoint)) %>%
    filter(timepoint_num %in% expected_timepoints) %>%
    group_by(timepoint_num) %>%
    summarise(mean_fc = mean(log2FoldChange, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") %>%
    rename(timepoint = timepoint_num)
  
  # Force insert 0 point if not present
  if(!0 %in% other_trend_raw$timepoint) {
    other_trend_raw <- bind_rows(
      data.frame(timepoint = 0, mean_fc = 0),
      other_trend_raw
    )
  }
  
  other_trend <- other_trend_raw %>%
    mutate(group = "Background", panel_group = cell_line) %>%
    arrange(timepoint)
  
  # --- 2. Calculate Normalization Factor ---
  local_max <- max(self_trend$mean_fc, na.rm = TRUE)
  scaling_factor <- ifelse(local_max > 0.1, local_max, 1) 
  
  # Normalize both Target and Background
  combined_df <- bind_rows(self_trend, other_trend) %>%
    mutate(scaled_fc = mean_fc / scaling_factor)
  
  spark_list[[cell_line]] <- combined_df
  
  # --- 3. Record Labels ---
  max_fc_labels[[cell_line]] <- data.frame(
    panel_group = cell_line,
    x_pos = 10, 
    y_pos = 1.5,
    label = paste0("Max: ", round(local_max, 1))
  )
}

sparkline_df <- bind_rows(spark_list)
label_df <- bind_rows(max_fc_labels)

# Ensure factor levels match boxplot order
sparkline_df$panel_group <- factor(sparkline_df$panel_group, levels = ordered_conditions)
label_df$panel_group <- factor(label_df$panel_group, levels = ordered_conditions)
sparkline_df$timepoint <- as.numeric(as.character(sparkline_df$timepoint))

# Filter to only include expected timepoints in the final plot
sparkline_df_filtered <- sparkline_df %>%
  filter(timepoint %in% expected_timepoints)

# --- 4. Plot Upper Part (Sparklines) ---

p_spark <- ggplot(sparkline_df_filtered, aes(x = timepoint, y = scaled_fc, group = group)) +
  # Background line
  geom_line(data = subset(sparkline_df_filtered, group == "Background"), 
            color = "grey80", size = 0.8) +
  
  # Target line (Area + Line)
  geom_area(data = subset(sparkline_df_filtered, group == "Target"), 
            fill = "#B2182B", alpha = 0.2) + 
  geom_line(data = subset(sparkline_df_filtered, group == "Target"), 
            color = "#B2182B", size = 0.8) +
  
  # Labels
  geom_text(data = label_df, aes(x = x_pos, y = y_pos, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE, 
            color = ifelse(label_df$label == "Control", "grey50", "#B2182B"),
            size = 3, hjust = 0) +
  
  # Faceting
  facet_grid(~ panel_group, switch = "x") +
  
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.1, "lines"), 
    plot.margin = margin(b = -10, l = 5, r = 5) 
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = expected_timepoints, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.5, 1.5))

# --- 5. Combine Plots ---

p_final <- p_spark / p_box + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 4))

# Save
ggsave("figures/fig1/Fig_Boxplot_with_Sparklines.pdf", 
       p_final, width = 14, height = 8)
```

```{r define_drgs_and_ribbon}
# ==============================================================================
# 1. Define Significant Genes (Filtering Strategy)
# ==============================================================================

# Filter 1: Statistical Significance
filtered_df <- all_results_df %>%
  filter(padj <= 0.01 & baseMean >= 20)

# Filter 2: Max Fold Change >= 1 (abs)
maxfc_df <- filtered_df %>%
  group_by(condition, gene_id) %>%
  summarize(
    max_fc = log2FoldChange[which.max(abs(log2FoldChange))],
    .groups = "drop"
  )

filtered_df <- filtered_df %>%
  left_join(maxfc_df, by = c("condition", "gene_id")) %>%
  filter(abs(max_fc) >= 1)

# Filter 3: Consistency in Late Timepoints (24, 48, 96h)
filtered_df <- filtered_df %>%
  mutate(
    up = log2FoldChange >= 0.58,
    down = log2FoldChange <= -0.58
  )

valid_time_points <- c(24, 48, 96)

trend_summary <- filtered_df %>%
  filter(timepoint %in% valid_time_points) %>%
  group_by(condition, gene_id) %>%
  summarize(
    up_count = sum(up, na.rm = TRUE),
    down_count = sum(down, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_comparisons = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # Must be present in all 3 late timepoints and consistently Up or Down
  filter(total_comparisons == length(valid_time_points)) %>%
  filter(up_count >= 3 | down_count >= 3)

# Determine Dominant Direction across all conditions
gene_dominant_conditions <- trend_summary %>%
  group_by(gene_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_up = sum(up_count > down_count),    # Count conditions where gene is Up
    n_down = sum(down_count > up_count),  # Count conditions where gene is Down
    dominant_direction = ifelse(n_up > n_down, "up", "down"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_up != n_down) # Remove ties

# Merge back to get the final long table
final_sig_genes <- filtered_df %>%
  left_join(gene_dominant_conditions, by = "gene_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(dominant_direction)) %>%
  # Keep only data matching the dominant direction
  filter((dominant_direction == "up" & up == TRUE) | (dominant_direction == "down" & down == TRUE))

# Annotate Gene Type
genes_gtf <- rtracklayer::import("/scratch/Shares/rinn/ML/hipsc_timecourse_GFP/genomes/gencode.v38.annotation.gene.gtf")
gene_annot_df <- as.data.frame(mcols(genes_gtf[genes_gtf$type == "gene"]))[, c("gene_id", "gene_type")]

final_sig_genes <- final_sig_genes %>%
  left_join(gene_annot_df, by = "gene_id")

write.csv(final_sig_genes, file = "results/final_sig_genes_log2fc1.csv")

# ==============================================================================
# 2. Define DRGs (Dox Response Genes Signature)
# ==============================================================================
# Definition: Shared in >= 21 out of 28 conditions (75%)

sig_genes_21_to_28 <- final_sig_genes %>%
  select(gene_id, gene_name, n_up, n_down) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(n_up >= 21 | n_down >= 21)

print(paste("DRGs Genes Identified:", nrow(sig_genes_21_to_28))) # Should be 209
write.csv(unique(sig_genes_21_to_28$gene_name), file = "results/sig_genes_21_to_28.csv")
save(sig_genes_21_to_28, file = "results/sig_genes_21_to_28.RData")

# Also save lncRNAs found in this high-frequency set
sig_lncRNA_18_to_24 <- final_sig_genes %>%
  filter(gene_type == "lncRNA") %>%
  group_by(gene_id, gene_name) %>%
  summarise(n_up = first(n_up), n_down = first(n_down)) %>%
  filter(n_up >= 21 | n_down >= 21)

write.csv(unique(sig_lncRNA_18_to_24$gene_name), file = "results/sig_lncRNA_18_to_24.csv")

# ==============================================================================
# 3. Visualization: Ribbon Plot (Stemness Collapse)
# ==============================================================================

# Prepare normalized counts
# Create a temp dds object to estimate size factors for all samples
# IMPORTANT: Remove gene_name column if present to avoid matrix error
combined_counts_clean <- combined_counts_plus %>% dplyr::select(-gene_name)
rownames(combined_counts_clean) <- combined_counts_clean$gene_id
combined_counts_clean <- combined_counts_clean[, -1] # Remove gene_id col

# Filter for relevant timepoints
keep_times <- c("0", "2", "4", "8", "16", "24", "48", "96")
col_data_filt <- col_data[as.character(col_data$time) %in% keep_times, ]
col_data_filt$time <- factor(as.character(col_data_filt$time), levels = keep_times)
combined_counts_filt <- as.matrix(combined_counts_clean[, col_data_filt$sample_id])

dds_norm <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = combined_counts_filt,
                                   colData = col_data_filt,
                                   design = ~ 1) 
dds_norm <- estimateSizeFactors(dds_norm)
norm_counts_mat <- counts(dds_norm, normalized = TRUE)

norm_counts_df <- as.data.frame(norm_counts_mat) %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene_id") %>%
  left_join(g2s, by = "gene_id")

# Select 12 Core Genes
collapse_genes <- c("NANOG", "MYC", "DNMT3B", "DPPA2", 
                    "GDF3", "PRDM14", "TERF1", "UTF1", 
                    "FOXD3", "HMOX1", "FOXO1", "KDR")

plot_data_long <- norm_counts_df %>%
  filter(gene_name %in% collapse_genes) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(gene_id, gene_name), names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "normalized_counts") %>%
  left_join(col_data, by = "sample_id") %>%
  mutate(time = as.numeric(as.character(time)))

# Calculate stats
plot_summary <- plot_data_long %>%
  group_by(gene_name, time) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_expr = mean(normalized_counts, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_expr = sd(normalized_counts, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()), 
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(ymin = mean_expr - se_expr, ymax = mean_expr + se_expr)

# Order genes
plot_summary$gene_name <- factor(plot_summary$gene_name, levels = collapse_genes)

# Plot
p_hallmark <- ggplot(plot_summary, aes(x = time, y = mean_expr)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax), fill = "#92C5DE", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_line(color = "#0571B0", linewidth = 0.75) + 
  geom_point(color = "black", size = 1.5) +       
  facet_wrap(~ gene_name, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) + 
  labs(
    x = "Time (Hours)", 
    y = "Normalized Counts (Mean ± SE)",
    title = "Rapid Collapse of the Pluripotency Core Network"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 4, 8, 24, 48, 96))
```

```{r pca_analysis}
# Prepare data with Batch information
col_data_filt$batch <- "batch1"

# Run VST

                                  colData = col_data_filt,
                                  design = ~ time)

mat <- assay(vst_data)

# Remove Batch Effect
mm <- model.matrix(~time, col_data_filt)
mat_corrected <- removeBatchEffect(mat, batch = col_data_filt$batch, design = mm)

# Run PCA
pca <- prcomp(t(mat_corrected))
percentVar <- round(100 * pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2))

                      time = col_data_filt$time, 
                      condition = col_data_filt$condition)

# Plot

  geom_point(size = 2.5, shape = 21) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#313695", mid = "#f7f7f7", high = "#a50026",
    midpoint = median(as.numeric(pcaData$time)),
    name = "Time (h)"
  ) +
  xlab(paste0("PC1: ", percentVar[1], "% variance")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2: ", percentVar[2], "% variance")) +
  theme_classic() +
  ggtitle("Global Trajectory")

ggsave("figures/fig1/PCA_Global_Trajectory.pdf", height = 5.5, width = 5)
```

```{r overlap analysis}
# Define a helper function to process individual datasets based on our criteria
# (Re-using logic from Chunk 4 but for individual subsets)
filtered_results <- filtered_df %>%
  inner_join(trend_summary[, c("condition", "gene_id")],
             by = c("condition", "gene_id"))

# Dynamic calculation of the total number of unique experimental conditions (clones)
total_conditions <- n_distinct(filtered_results$condition)
print(paste("Total clones/conditions:", total_conditions))

# Assign the processed dataframe to a final variable for consistency
# The 'condition' column is crucial and will not be cleaned or renamed
data_full <- filtered_results

# 函数：从条件名中提取基本名称
extract_base_name <- function(cond_name) {
  # 移除"c[数字]"前缀
  base_name <- str_remove(cond_name, "c[0-9].*")
  # 移除下划线后的部分
  base_name <- str_remove(base_name, "_.*")
  return(base_name)
}

# 自定义排序函数
custom_order <- function(condition_names) {
  # 提取每个条件的基本名称
  base_names <- sapply(condition_names, extract_base_name)
  
  # 分离WT和GFP
  wt_conditions <- condition_names[base_names == "WT"]
  gfp_conditions <- condition_names[base_names == "GFP"]
  
  # 获取其他条件
  other_conditions <- condition_names[!(base_names %in% c("WT", "GFP"))]
  
  # 对其他条件按基本名称字母排序
  if (length(other_conditions) > 0) {
    # 提取其他条件的基本名称
    other_base_names <- sapply(other_conditions, extract_base_name)
    # 按基本名称字母排序
    other_conditions_sorted <- other_conditions[order(other_base_names)]
  } else {
    other_conditions_sorted <- character(0)
  }
  
  # 合并：先WT，再GFP，然后其他按字母排序
  return(c(wt_conditions, gfp_conditions, other_conditions_sorted))
}

# 获取所有唯一条件
all_conditions <- unique(data_full$condition)

# 应用自定义排序
custom_order_vec <- custom_order(all_conditions)

# 将condition转换为因子，应用自定义排序
data_full$condition <- factor(data_full$condition, levels = custom_order_vec)

# Calculate how many specific conditions (clones) each gene appears in
# 使用提取的基本名称进行分析
gene_counts <- data_full %>%
  mutate(base_name = extract_base_name(condition)) %>%
  group_by(gene_id) %>%
  summarize(
    n_conds = n_distinct(base_name),  # 基于基本名称计数
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # Assign each gene to a sharing category based on the percentage of total_conditions
  mutate(
    share_category = case_when(
      n_conds == 1 ~ "Unique (Clone-Specific)",         # Appears in only one clone
      n_conds <= total_conditions * 0.25 ~ "Low Shared (<25%)",   # Appears in <25% of clones
      n_conds <= total_conditions * 0.50 ~ "Medium Shared (<50%)", # Appears in <50% of clones
      n_conds <= total_conditions * 0.75 ~ "High Shared (<75%)",  # Appears in <75% of clones
      TRUE ~ "Consistant Response (>=75%)"                       # Appears in >=75% of clones (Highly conserved)
    )
  )

# 为了绘图，我们需要将原始条件名称与排序后的因子顺序对齐
# 首先创建一个映射：条件 -> 基本名称
condition_base_map <- data_full %>%
  distinct(condition) %>%
  mutate(base_name = extract_base_name(condition))

summary_df <- data_full %>%
  # Ensure only unique condition-gene_id pairs are counted (preventing double counting)
  distinct(condition, gene_id) %>%
  # Join the calculated sharing category for each gene
  left_join(gene_counts, by = "gene_id") %>%
  # Join base name for ordering
  left_join(condition_base_map, by = "condition") %>%
  # Group by condition and sharing category to count genes in each category
  group_by(condition, share_category, base_name) %>%
  summarize(gene_count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  # Calculate percentage within each condition
  group_by(condition) %>%
  mutate(
    total_genes = sum(gene_count),
    pct = gene_count / total_genes * 100 # Percentage of DEGs in this clone belonging to this category
  ) %>%
  # 确保condition保持正确的因子顺序
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = custom_order_vec))

# Set the desired order for the stacked bars (from most conserved to most specific)
summary_df$share_category <- factor(summary_df$share_category,
                                    levels = c("Consistant Response (>=75%)",
                                               "High Shared (<75%)",
                                               "Medium Shared (<50%)",
                                               "Low Shared (<25%)",
                                               "Unique (Clone-Specific)"))

# --- 5. Generate Stacked Bar Plot ---
ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = condition, y = pct, fill = share_category)) +
  # Use geom_col for a standard stacked bar chart
  geom_col(width = 0.78) +

  # Define specific colors for each category (from dark/core to light/specific)
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Consistant Response (>=75%)" = "#252525", # Black/Dark Gray: Highly Conserved Genes
      "High Shared (<75%)"          = "#525252",
      "Medium Shared (<50%)"        = "#737373",
      "Low Shared (<25%)"           = "#969696",
      "Unique (Clone-Specific)"     = "#2166AC"  # Blue: Unique Genes (Highlights Specificity)
    )
  ) +

  # Set Y-axis limits and remove expansion/padding
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 100.1)) +

  # Apply a clean, classic theme
  theme_classic() +
  # Set labels and title
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Percentage of DEGs (%)",
    fill = "Consistency",
    title = "Conservation of Transcriptomic Response Across Cells/Clones"
  ) +

  # Customize plot elements for publication quality
  theme(
    # Rotate X-axis text for long clone names
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, color = "black", size = 9.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "grey50"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm")
  )

# Save the plot as a PDF file
ggsave(
  path = "~/RNAseq/RNAseq_FULL_MODEL/combined time/figures/fig2",
  filename = "Conservation of Transcriptomic Response Across Cells.pdf",
  height = 10, width = 15, limitsize = FALSE
)

process_df_subset <- function(df) {
  df_filt <- df %>% filter(padj <= 0.01 & baseMean >= 20)
  
  maxfc <- df_filt %>% group_by(condition, gene_id) %>%
    summarize(max_fc = log2FoldChange[which.max(abs(log2FoldChange))], .groups="drop")
  
  df_filt <- df_filt %>% left_join(maxfc) %>% filter(abs(max_fc) >= 1) %>%
    mutate(up = log2FoldChange >= 0.58, down = log2FoldChange <= -0.58)
  
  valid_tps <- c(24, 48, 96)
  trend <- df_filt %>% filter(timepoint %in% valid_tps) %>%
    group_by(condition, gene_id) %>%
    summarize(up_count=sum(up, na.rm=T), down_count=sum(down, na.rm=T), 
              total=n(), .groups="drop") %>%
    filter(total==3 & (up_count>=3 | down_count>=3))
  
  # Determine direction per gene
  final <- trend %>% group_by(gene_id) %>%
    summarise(n_up = sum(up_count > down_count), 
              n_down = sum(down_count > up_count), .groups="drop")
  return(final)
}

# 1. Extract raw results for specific groups

wt_df <- all_results_df %>% filter(condition == "WT")

# 2. Process them

linc667_sig <- process_df_subset(linc667_df) %>% filter(n_up >= 3 | n_down >= 3)
tug1_sig <- process_df_subset(tug1_df) %>% filter(n_up >= 1 | n_down >= 1)

# 3. Create UpSet Plot

upset(fromList(genes_list), nsets = 4, text.scale = 1.5,

# 4. Create Venn Diagram (using ggvenn)
```

```{r heatmap_visualization_DRGs}
# 获取所有唯一条件

# Calculate the average expression trajectory across ALL conditions for each gene

  group_by(gene_id, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(mean_fc = mean(log2FoldChange, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%

gene_dist <- dist(gene_avg_matrix)           # Calculate Euclidean distance between gene trajectories

    # Minimize the spacing between facets to make the plot appear continuous
```

```{r enrichment_analysis}
# Set a publication-grade theme for ggplot2
theme_pub <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "right",
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95")

# Define and create output directory
output_dir <- "~/RNAseq/RNAseq_FULL_MODEL/combined time/figures/fig2/Enrichment_Publication/"
if(!dir.exists(output_dir)) dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)

# 1. DATA PREPARATION (ID Conversion)
message("Preparing gene IDs...")

# A. Target Genes (Differentially Expressed Genes)
# Assume 'sig_genes_21_to_28' is the dataframe of DEGs
target_genes_df <- sig_genes_21_to_28
# Clean ENSEMBL IDs by removing version numbers (e.g., ENSG00000XXX.Y -> ENSG00000XXX)
target_genes_df$gene_id_clean <- gsub("\\..*", "", target_genes_df$gene_id)

# Convert ENSEMBL to ENTREZID (for clusterProfiler) and SYMBOL (for readability/enrichR)
gene_convert <- bitr(target_genes_df$gene_id_clean,
                     fromType = "ENSEMBL",
                     toType = c("ENTREZID", "SYMBOL"),
                     OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)

target_entrez <- unique(gene_convert$ENTREZID)
target_symbol <- unique(gene_convert$SYMBOL)

# B. Background Genes (Universe) - Required for statistical rigor in GO/ORA
# Filter for genes passing an expression threshold (e.g., baseMean >= 20)
universe_df <- all_results_df %>% filter(baseMean >= 20)
universe_df$gene_id_clean <- gsub("\\..*", "", universe_df$gene_id)

# Convert the background gene list to ENTREZID
universe_convert <- bitr(universe_df$gene_id_clean,
                         fromType = "ENSEMBL",
                         toType = "ENTREZID",
                         OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)
universe_entrez <- unique(universe_convert$ENTREZID)

message(paste("Target gene count (ENTREZID):", length(target_entrez)))
message(paste("Background gene count (ENTREZID):", length(universe_entrez)))

# 2. GO ENRICHMENT ANALYSIS (using clusterProfiler + Custom Universe)
message("Running GO enrichment analysis...")

# Function to run enrichGO for a specified ontology (BP or CC)
run_go <- function(ont) {
  enrichGO(gene          = target_entrez,      # Target gene list
           universe      = universe_entrez,    # Custom background (universe) gene list
           OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,       # Organism database (Human)
           ont           = ont,                # Ontology: "BP" or "CC"
           pAdjustMethod = "BH",               # Multiple testing correction
           pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,               # P-value cutoff for filtering
           qvalueCutoff  = 0.2,                # Q-value cutoff (qvalue < 0.2 is common for GO)
           readable      = TRUE)               # Convert ENTREZID back to SYMBOL
}

ego_BP <- run_go("BP") # Biological Process
ego_CC <- run_go("CC") # Cellular Component

# Convert the enrichment results (S4 object) to a standard data frame
go_results_df <- as.data.frame(ego_BP)

# Filter the results to include only statistically significant terms (padj < 0.05)
significant_terms_df <- go_results_df %>%
  filter(p.adjust < 0.05) %>%
  # Arrange the results by adjusted p-value for presentation
  arrange(p.adjust)

  # --- Export to CSV ---
  output_filename <- paste0(output_dir, "Significant_GO_BP_Terms_p05.csv")
  
  # Export the data frame to a CSV file
  write.csv(
    significant_terms_df,
    output_filename,
    row.names = FALSE
  )
# --- GO Visualization (Dot Plot) ---
# Creates a dot plot where size represents gene count and color represents adjusted P-value

p_bp <- plot_go_dot(ego_BP, "GO Biological Process (Dox Response)")
p_cc <- plot_go_dot(ego_CC, "GO Cellular Component (Dox Response)")

# Save plots

ggsave(paste0(output_dir, "GO_CC_Dotplot.pdf"), p_cc, width = 9, height = 8)

# --- GO Visualization (Network Plot - Cnetplot) ---
# Shows the relationship between enriched pathways and the genes that overlap between them
p_cnet <- cnetplot(ego_BP, showCategory = 5, circular = FALSE, colorEdge = TRUE,
                   cex_label_category = 1.2, cex_label_gene = 0.8) +
  ggtitle("Gene-Pathway Interaction")

ggsave(paste0(output_dir, "GO_BP_Network.pdf"), p_cnet, width = 12, height = 8)

# 3. DIRECTIONAL ANALYSIS AND EXPORT

# --- Prepare Log2FC Vector ---
fc_column_name <- "log2FoldChange"

# 1. Extract Symbol and Log2FC (Assuming log2FoldChange is a column in target_genes_df)
gene_fc_info <- target_genes_df %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id_clean, all_of(fc_column_name)) %>%
  # Join with the ID conversion table to map Ensembl to Symbol
  left_join(gene_convert, by = c("gene_id_clean" = "ENSEMBL")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(SYMBOL)) %>%
  distinct(SYMBOL, .keep_all = TRUE) # Keep distinct symbols (resolves multi-mapping issues)

# 2. Build the named vector required for analysis (Symbol as names, log2FC as values)
gene_fc_vector <- gene_fc_info[[fc_column_name]]
names(gene_fc_vector) <- gene_fc_info$SYMBOL

# Sort the vector (Optional, but good practice for visual inspection)
gene_fc_vector <- sort(gene_fc_vector, decreasing = TRUE)

# --- Define Direction Counting Function ---
# This function determines the number of up/down-regulated genes within a pathway
count_direction <- function(gene_str, fc_vec) {
  # Split the geneID string (e.g., "GENE_A/GENE_B")
  genes <- unlist(strsplit(gene_str, "/"))

  # Get log2FC values for these genes
  fcs <- fc_vec[genes]
  fcs <- fcs[!is.na(fcs)] # Remove non-matched genes

  n_up <- sum(fcs > 0)
  n_down <- sum(fcs < 0)

  return(c(n_up, n_down))
}

# --- Apply Direction Counting and Classification ---
res_df <- as.data.frame(ego_BP) # Get the BP results table

# Create new columns
res_df$Count_Up <- 0
res_df$Count_Down <- 0
res_df$Direction_Status <- ""

# Loop through each enriched pathway to calculate direction counts
for(i in 1:nrow(res_df)) {
  counts <- count_direction(res_df$geneID[i], gene_fc_vector)
  res_df$Count_Up[i] <- counts[1]
  res_df$Count_Down[i] <- counts[2]

  # Classification logic: Pathway is directional if one direction count is more than double the other
  if (counts[1] > counts[2] * 2) {
    res_df$Direction_Status[i] <- "Activated (Mostly Up)"
  } else if (counts[2] > counts[1] * 2) {
    res_df$Direction_Status[i] <- "Suppressed (Mostly Down)"
  } else {
    res_df$Direction_Status[i] <- "Mixed" # Both up and down genes are represented
  }
}

# --- Final Table Export ---
final_table <- res_df %>%
  # Select and reorder relevant columns for clarity
  dplyr::select(Description, p.adjust, Count, Count_Up, Count_Down, Direction_Status, geneID) %>%
  filter(p.adjust < 0.05) %>% # Ensure only statistically significant pathways are exported
  arrange(p.adjust)          # Sort by adjusted P-value

# Export the final table with directional information
write.csv(final_table, paste0(output_dir, "Full_GO_Pathways_With_Direction.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r gsea_analysis}

# 1: PREPARE CUSTOM GENE SIGNATURE
# Read your core list of significant genes
final_sig_genes <- read.csv("~/RNAseq/RNAseq_FULL_MODEL/combined time/results/final_sig_genes_log2fc1.csv", row.names = 1)

# Helper function to remove Ensembl ID version numbers (e.g., ENSG00000XXX.Y -> ENSG00000XXX)
trim_version <- function(x) sub("\\.\\d+$", "", x)

# Extract and clean gene IDs for the UP-regulated component (n_up >= 21 timepoints)
n_up <- final_sig_genes %>%
  filter(!is.na(n_up), n_up >= 21) %>%
  pull(gene_id) %>%
  as.character() %>%
  trim_version() %>%
  unique()

# Extract and clean gene IDs for the DOWN-regulated component
n_down <- final_sig_genes %>%
  filter(!is.na(n_down), n_down >= 21) %>%
  pull(gene_id) %>%
  as.character() %>%
  trim_version() %>%
  unique()

# Construct the custom gene set list for fgsea
my_signature <- list(
  My_UP_Stress = n_up,
  My_DOWN_Collapse = n_down
)

# Optional function to save the signature as a GMT file
write_gmt <- function(gene_list, file){
  con <- file(file, "w")
  on.exit(close(con))
  for (gs_name in names(gene_list)) {
    cat(gs_name, "NA", paste(gene_list[[gs_name]], collapse = "\t"),
        sep = "\t", file = con)
    cat("\n", file = con)
  }
}
# write_gmt(my_signature, "my_signature.gmt") 

# 2: LOAD PUBLIC DATA AND PROCESS IDs

df <- read.table(
  "~/RNAseq/RNAseq_FULL_MODEL/combined time/figures/fig5/PSC/GSE236795_raw_counts_GRCh38.p13_NCBI.tsv",
  header = TRUE, row.names = 1, sep = "\t", check.names = FALSE
)

# Remove non-count columns (assuming first 8 columns are metadata)
# NOTE: Check your file structure to ensure -c(1:8) is correct
colnames(df)
df<-df[, -c(1:8)]
colnames(df)

# --- ID CONVERSION (NCBI Entrez ID -> Ensembl ID) ---
ncbi_ids <- rownames(df)

# Map Entrez IDs (keytype) to Ensembl IDs (column)
mapped_ids <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db,
                     keys = ncbi_ids,
                     column = "ENSEMBL",
                     keytype = "ENTREZID",
                     multiVals = "first") # Take the first mapping in case of one-to-many

# Add the Ensembl IDs as a new column
df$ensembl_id <- mapped_ids

# --- Handle ID Ambiguity (Filtering and Aggregation) ---
# Remove rows where no Ensembl ID was mapped
df_clean <- df[!is.na(df$ensembl_id), ]

# Aggregate counts for multiple NCBI IDs mapping to the same Ensembl ID (sum counts)
df_aggregated <- df_clean %>%
  group_by(ensembl_id) %>%
  # Summarize by summing counts across all sample columns
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum)) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Set Ensembl ID as row names and finalize the count matrix
rownames(df_aggregated) <- df_aggregated$ensembl_id
df_final <- df_aggregated[, -1] # Remove the redundant ensembl_id column

# 3: DESeq2 ANALYSIS

# Manually define conditions vector (CRITICAL: MUST match colnames(df_final) order)
conditions_vec <- c("treatment","control", "control", "treatment", "treatment","control", "control", "treatment", "treatment","control", "control")

# Check for sample count mismatch
if(length(conditions_vec) != ncol(df_final)) {
  stop("ERROR: The number of defined sample conditions does not match the number of data columns!")
}

# Create the sample metadata dataframe (colData)
sample_info <- data.frame(
  condition = factor(conditions_vec, levels = c("control", "treatment")), # Set 'control' as the reference level
  row.names = colnames(df_final)
)

# Construct DESeq object
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = round(df_final), # DESeq2 requires integer counts
  colData = sample_info,
  design = ~ condition
)

# --- Run DESeq (using the default Wald Test for two-group comparison) ---
dds <- DESeq(dds)

# Extract results, explicitly defining the contrast: Treatment vs. Control
res <- results(dds, contrast = c("condition", "treatment", "control"))

# 4 & 5: PREPARE RANKING AND RUN GSEA

# Use the Wald Statistic ('stat') for ranking (more robust than log2FC in GSEA)
rnk_vec <- res$stat
names(rnk_vec) <- rownames(res)

# Remove NA values and sort the vector
rnk_vec <- rnk_vec[!is.na(rnk_vec)]
# Add a small noise to handle ties (important for GSEA algorithm)
noise <- runif(length(rnk_vec), min = -1e-10, max = 1e-10)
rnk_vec <- rnk_vec + noise
rnk_vec <- sort(rnk_vec, decreasing = TRUE)

# Optional: Save the ranked list (.rnk file format)
rnk_df <- data.frame(Gene = names(rnk_vec), Score = rnk_vec)
# write.table(rnk_df, "public_data_ranking.rnk", sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE)

# --- Run fgsea ---
set.seed(42) # Ensure reproducibility

fgseaRes <- fgsea(
  pathways = my_signature,        # Your custom gene sets
  stats    = rnk_vec,             # The ranked list
  minSize  = 5,                    # Minimum gene set size (set lower for small signatures)
  maxSize  = 500
)

# View and print final results
print(fgseaRes[order(fgseaRes$padj), ])

# 6: VISUALIZATION
# Helper function to plot GSEA results and add statistical labels
plot_gsea_custom <- function(pathway_id, stats_vec, title_text) {
  # Get NES and Padj values for labeling
  res_row <- fgseaRes[fgseaRes$pathway == pathway_id, ]
  stats_label <- paste0("NES: ", round(res_row$NES, 2), "\nPadj: ", formatC(res_row$padj, format = "e", digits = 2))

  plotEnrichment(my_signature[[pathway_id]], stats_vec) +
    labs(title = title_text, subtitle = stats_label) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
}

# Plot UP component (expect positive NES if similar response)
p1 <- plot_gsea_custom("My_UP_Stress", rnk_vec, "GSE236795: Enrichment of DOX UP Signature")

# Plot DOWN component (expect negative NES if similar response)
p2 <- plot_gsea_custom("My_DOWN_Collapse", rnk_vec, "GSE236795: Enrichment of DOX DOWN Signature")

# Combine plots
combined_plot <- grid.arrange(p1, p2, ncol = 2)

# Save combined plot
ggsave(
  "~/RNAseq/RNAseq_FULL_MODEL/combined time/figures/fig5/PSC/GSE236795_GSEA_Result_PublicData.pdf",
  combined_plot,
  width = 12, height = 6
)

# 7: AGGREGATE RESULTS FOR BUBBLE MATRIX

# Initialize summary table (if it doesn't exist from previous runs)
if (!exists("gsea_summary_df")) {
  gsea_summary_df <- data.frame(
    dataset = character(),
    pathway = character(),
    NES = numeric(),
    pval = numeric(),
    padj = numeric(),
    size = integer(),
    leadingEdge = character(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

current_dataset <- "GSE236795"
current_condition <- "treatment_vs_control"

# Add current results to the summary table
for (i in 1:nrow(fgseaRes)) {
  pathway_result <- fgseaRes[i, ]

  # Convert leadingEdge list to a semicolon-separated string
  leading_edge_str <- paste(pathway_result$leadingEdge[[1]], collapse = ";")

  new_row <- data.frame(
    dataset = current_dataset,
    pathway = pathway_result$pathway,
    NES = pathway_result$NES,
    pval = pathway_result$pval,
    padj = pathway_result$padj,
    size = pathway_result$size,
    leadingEdge = leading_edge_str,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  gsea_summary_df <- rbind(gsea_summary_df, new_row)
}

# Save the cumulative summary dataframe
save(gsea_summary_df, file = "~/RNAseq/RNAseq_FULL_MODEL/combined time/figures/fig5/my_signature_gsea_summary_df.RData")

# 9: FORMAT DATA FOR BUBBLE MATRIX

# Mapping of GEO IDs (Dataset names) to Cell Types
cell_type_map <- list(
  "Stem Cell" = c("159778", "161634", "171803", "204934", "236795", "251814", "260618"),
  "HCT116"    = c("62889", "73317", "114946", "121207", "158672", "234395"),
  "HEK293"    = c("100132", "142895", "205721", "208379", "219008", "221838"),
  "HeLa"      = c("201019", "271430"),
  "MCF-7"     = c("128458", "175401")
)

# Robust function to assign Cell Type based on dataset name (using partial ID match)
get_cell_type_robust <- function(dataset_name) {
  for (type in names(cell_type_map)) {
    ids <- cell_type_map[[type]]
    # Check if the dataset_name contains any of the mapped GEO IDs
    if (any(sapply(ids, function(id) grepl(id, dataset_name)))) {
      return(type)
    }
  }
  return("Other Type") # Default for unmapped datasets
}

# Process the aggregated data for plotting
plot_data <- gsea_summary_df %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(Cell_Type = get_cell_type_robust(dataset)) %>% # Assign Cell Type
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(log_pval = -log10(padj)) %>%
  # Cap the -log10(padj) value to prevent 'Inf' issues in scaling
  mutate(log_pval = ifelse(is.infinite(log_pval), 50, log_pval)) %>%
  mutate(sig_label = ifelse(padj < 0.05, "*", "")) %>% # Create significance asterisk label
  # Clean up pathway names for the plot Y-axis
  mutate(pathway_label = case_when(
    pathway == "My_DOWN_Collapse" ~ "Stemness Collapse (Down)",
    pathway == "My_UP_Stress" ~ "Stress/De-repression (Up)",
    TRUE ~ pathway
  ))

# Set factor levels for correct ordering on the plot
plot_data$Cell_Type <- factor(plot_data$Cell_Type,
                              levels = c("Stem Cell", "HCT116", "HEK293", "HeLa", "MCF-7", "Other Type"))

plot_data$pathway_label <- factor(plot_data$pathway_label,
                                  levels = c("Stress/De-repression (Up)", "Stemness Collapse (Down)"))

# Step 10: DRAW BUBBLE MATRIX
p_bubble_guided <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = dataset, y = pathway_label)) +

  # --- Vertical Guide Lines ---
  # These lines visually connect the paired UP/DOWN pathways for each dataset
  geom_line(aes(group = dataset), color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.5) +

  # 1. Bubble Layer: size = significance, fill = NES
  geom_point(aes(fill = NES, size = log_pval),
             shape = 21,
             color = "grey30",
             stroke = 0.3) +

  # 2. Color Scale: Diverging RdBu palette for NES
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "RdBu", direction = -1,
                       limits = c(-3, 3), oob = scales::squish,
                       name = "NES") +

  # 3. Size Scale: Map -log10(FDR) to bubble size
  scale_size(range = c(3, 12), name = "-log10(FDR)") +

  # 4. Significance Text Layer
  geom_text(aes(label = sig_label), vjust = 0.78, size = 6, color = "black") +

  # 5. Facet: Separate the plot by Cell Type
  facet_grid(~ Cell_Type, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +

  # 6. Theme and Labels
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    x = "Independent Datasets",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Specificity of Stemness Collapse to Pluripotent Cells",
    subtitle = "Vertical lines indicate paired pathways for each independent dataset"
  ) +
  theme(
    # Hide X-axis labels as the vertical lines serve as visual identifiers for datasets
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),

    # Y-axis text
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),

    # Remove default grid lines
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

    # Facet strip customization
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),

    legend.position = "right",
    panel.spacing = unit(0.2, "lines")
  )

print(p_bubble_guided)

# Save the final bubble matrix
ggsave(
  filename = "~/RNAseq/RNAseq_FULL_MODEL/combined time/figures/fig5/Fig5_Bubble_Final.pdf",
  plot = p_bubble_guided,
  width = 13, height = 5
)
```
